name: A long list shown as a complete set
useWhen: Ten to sixteen offerings have to be seen as a whole, where the breadth is the point rather than any one item.

focal.note: Flat throughout. Sixteen peers on one slide cannot have a hero without lying about the set.

replacesNote: columns-v2 tops out at four items. At sixteen a bulleted list reads as a wall.

deviations.source: set on the same baseline and print through each other
